acceptedScope: immutable predecessor lineage, bounded lifecycle record, fail-closed evidence-before-lifecycle ordering, receipt binding, protected-content gates, and external-authority exclusions
findings: Exact lowercase SHA-256 identity and selector-structure guards reject malformed coupled lifecycle values.
Execution, freeze, receipt, and handoff chronology plus future-time, consumer-instruction, PostgreSQL semantic, and external-authority guards remain fail closed.
Complete evidence and selector validation precede lifecycle selection while isolated lifecycle modes remain non-authorizing.
